testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/my-account/edit-profile-validate-functionality.spec.ts > Webstore - My Account - Edit Profile > validate edit profile functionality

scenario.summary: The signed-in registered user opens Edit Profile, checks the heading, clears first and last name and checks the required-field messages, then saves valid first name, last name and phone number and checks the profile-updated toast.
steps: Open Edit Profile (signed in through the shared storageState); check the heading
Clear First Name and Last Name; check each required-field message; submit while invalid
Fill first name, last name, phone number; submit; check 'Profile updated successfully.'
stateChanges: The signed-in account's first name, last name and phone number are overwritten with the test's values
assertions: First and last name required messages
evidence: Title 'validate edit profile functionality' and the step labels match the flow

DECLARED ACCOUNT: the spec runs in the webstore-auth project (playwright.testim-webstore.config.ts, AUTH_SPECS my-account/**) signed in through the shared storageState written by testim-migrated/tests/auth.setup.ts, whose account is getMyAccountUser() (src/data/credentials.ts) = loadEnvironment().myAccountUser, username from env var MY_ACCOUNT_USERNAME (src/config/env.ts:80, set in the git-ignored .env.<env>, not in the test's JSON). Source 0 records that credential (masked). The test declares it with await testData.useExisting('user', getMyAccountUser().username) before its first step (the same account as the session)

Store MaxwellsHardware: webstore-auth uses testimEnv.web.baseUrl (WEB_BASE_URL, default webstore-z10-at), the store every migrated webstore spec runs on; the account's recorded records (orders, saved carts) are on PortalId 7 = MaxwellsHardware (tda rows)

The test needs no record besides the account: the new name and phone values are typed in by the test (created-by-test); firstNameValidation/lastNameValidation are validation messages masked only by key name; the 'First Name'/'Last Name'/'Phone Number' literals are field labels (config)

swap: no data value (nothing to replace); the spec stays as it is. The user need is only checked at pre-warm (the account is not declared or leased); to declare and lease it, use strategy migrate and add the useExisting line above (the test changes the account's profile)
